question: If a + b = 41 and a - b = 38, find the value of (a+b)².
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the value of **(a + b)** directly from the given information.

Given **a + b = 41**.

To find **(a + b)²**, simply square the value of 41.

41² = 1681.

**∴ The correct answer is 1681.**
